name: BeamEndpoint
title: Beam Endpoint
description: Calls a model the org has deployed on Beam and returns what it answers
whenToUse: Pick when a step needs a model the org hosts itself rather than a vendor's: an open model from Hugging Face for entity extraction, classification, embeddings or anything else, deployed in the org's own Beam workspace. The step sends the model its input as JSON and passes on the model's answer exactly as it came back. The first call after a quiet spell waits while the model wakes; later calls are quick.

inputs.name: signal
inputs.description: Upstream data; the input field reads from it

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The model's answer, exactly as the deployment returned it

url.title: Endpoint
url.description: The deployment's address as Beam printed it on deploy, such as https://gliner2-2d45be7-v2.app.beam.cloud.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model the deployment runs, as its page names it ("NuExtract3", "Splink"). Shown beside the node wherever the step is drawn; the call does not send it.

input.title: Input
input.description: What the model is sent, as a return expression: the fields its deployment reads, such as { text, labels } for entity extraction.

authRequired.title: Require sign-in
authRequired.description: Only a signed-in caller may run this step. Leave off and it runs for whoever the workflow's trigger admitted, which is the usual answer.

authRole.title: Require role
authRole.description: A claim the caller's account must carry, as noun:verb (finance:approve, payments:refund). Leave blank to require only that they are signed in.

package.name: beam
package.packageFile:
# BEAM (beam.cloud): a model the org deploys in its own Beam workspace, called as a node. The
# model runs in Beam's container, which sleeps when idle and is billed by the second; the platform
# holds only the endpoint's address and the workspace token (owner, 2026-10-09: "create a node to
# interact with a beam deployment", "I don't want any beam in my project").

name: beam
displayName: Beam
description: Call a model deployed on Beam (beam.cloud) as a workflow step
version: 0.1.0
category: ai
publisher: unoverse
logoUrl: https://res.cloudinary.com/sonik/image/upload/v1791554598/gravity/icons/beam.png

features:
  - Any model the org deploys on Beam, called by its endpoint address
  - Scales to zero between calls; the first call after a sleep waits for the container to start

# Every Beam endpoint is its own subdomain: gliner2-2d45be7-v2.app.beam.cloud.
allowedHosts:
  - "**.app.beam.cloud"

requires:
  credential: [bearer]
  transport: [json]
  executorVersion: ">=1.4.0"

credentials.beamCredential.yaml:
# The SHAPE of the credential, never its value: a Beam workspace token, sent as a bearer token to
# the workspace's endpoints. The value is added on the platform, as every node key is.

name: beamCredential
displayName: Beam
description: The token of the Beam workspace whose endpoints this calls
documentationUrl: https://docs.beam.cloud

properties:
  - name: token
    displayName: Token
    type: string
    required: true
    secret: true
    description: Your Beam workspace token, from the Beam dashboard

files.api/events.yaml:
# One row per output, in interface.yaml's order. The answer is passed on whole.
- emit: result
  value: "return response"
files.api/run.yaml:
- name: call
  method: POST
  url: "return String(config.url || '').trim()"

  credential:
    scheme: bearer
    token: "{{ credentials.beamCredential.token }}"

  body: "return config.input || {}"

  # A sleeping deployment starts its container and loads its model before it answers: measured
  # 37 s for a 194M-parameter model on its first call ever, about 1 s once warm.
  timeoutMs: 300000

  retry:
    attempts: 3
    backoff: exponential
    on: [429, 502, 503, 504]

  transport: json

  # A deployment that answers 200 with an error in its body has failed.
  error:
    when: "return !!(response && response.error)"
    message: "return String(response.error)"
files.config.yaml:
configSchema:
  type: object
  required: [url, input]

  properties:
    url:
      type: string
      title: Endpoint
      description: >-
        The deployment's address as Beam printed it on deploy, such as
        https://gliner2-2d45be7-v2.app.beam.cloud.
      default: ""

    model:
      type: string
      title: Model
      description: >-
        The model the deployment runs, as its page names it ("NuExtract3", "Splink"). Shown beside
        the node wherever the step is drawn; the call does not send it.
      default: ""

    input:
      type: object
      title: Input
      description: >-
        What the model is sent, as a return expression: the fields its deployment reads, such as
        { text, labels } for entity extraction.
      default: {}
      ui:field: template
ui:order: [url, model, input]
files.interface.yaml:
inputs:
  - name: signal
    type: object
    description: Upstream data; the input field reads from it

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: object
    description: The model's answer, exactly as the deployment returned it

credentials:
  - name: beamCredential
    required: true
    displayName: Beam
files.node.yaml:
type: BeamEndpoint
kind: PromiseNode

name: Beam Endpoint
category: AI
color: "#5B5BD6"

description: Calls a model the org has deployed on Beam and returns what it answers

whenToUse: >-
  Pick when a step needs a model the org hosts itself rather than a vendor's: an open model from
  Hugging Face for entity extraction, classification, embeddings or anything else, deployed in
  the org's own Beam workspace. The step sends the model its input as JSON and passes on the
  model's answer exactly as it came back. The first call after a quiet spell waits while the
  model wakes; later calls are quick.

auth:
  required: false

capabilities:
  # A model call: its answer may differ run to run, and the deployment may change under it.
  cacheable: false
files.test.yaml:
testData:
  config:
    url: https://gliner2-2d45be7-v2.app.beam.cloud
    input:
      text: "Class B Shares, Management Fee Rate = Until 31 December 2026, 1.25%."
      labels: [share class, management fee rate]

  inputs:
    signal: {}

  expect:
    # Proves the deployment answered with entities under the labels asked, not their exact words.
    result: "return !!output.result.entities && Array.isArray(output.result.entities['share class'])"
